sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Target only the authoritative ship owner: add `?this a nltl:ship` to the applicability target (or an equivalent ship-specific target), rather than targeting any node that happens to carry category and construction-date properties. Also remove the unconditional `sh:minCount 1` on ship-owned `residualStabilityFactorSI`: the every-loading-condition rule does not independently require an s_i value when no applicable loading-condition case exists. Rework the constraint so s_i presence/equality is required conditionally for applicable loading-condition cases while retaining `residualStabilityFactorSI` on its authoritative ship owner; do not move it onto the loading-condition case.

Preserve the ship-specific applicability target. Remove the residualStabilityFactorSI sh:minCount 1 requirement from the non-alternative branch: it still creates the previously identified accidental failure when the ship has no applicable loading-condition cases. Rework the non-alternative condition so that s_i=1 is required only conditionally for each applicable loading-condition case, while retaining residualStabilityFactorSI on its authoritative ship owner; do not relocate it to the case. The current existential ship-level equality permits one s_i=1 to satisfy the branch without enforcing the universal per-loading-condition requirement. Retain the alternative branch's required selector/status and per-case evidence requirement so missing branch-selection evidence cannot pass.
